free_tier.stated: the Windsurf SKU is served on Devin's ladder: Free USD 0, 'Light quota to code with agents', Unlimited inline edits, Unlimited Tab completions
free_tier.notes: windsurf.com/pricing returns 308 to devin.ai/pricing, and windsurf.com itself 308s to devin.ai/desktop. There is no separate Windsurf price list. The pricing fact is Devin's, and it is recorded once, in dossier/coding-subs/devin.json

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

interface_detail: an editor and a desktop client served from devin.ai/desktop; no documented programmatic API key
chaining: the editor and agent quota are the scarce link; the product now shares a ladder and a quota system with Devin, so it is not an independent second quota in a stack

limits.value: the Free plan's agent quota is described as 'Light quota to code with agents' with no number, on the Devin ladder the host now serves

limits_note: no countable allowance is stated for agent work on any tier. Inline edits and Tab completions are stated as unlimited on Free
binding_note: the unpublished agent quota binds, and it is the same quota system Devin sells, so pairing Windsurf with Devin buys no independence

identity_cost.detail: through the Devin ladder; the Free plan is USD 0 and the paid tiers are bought with a card

reliability_note: the windsurf.com host 308-redirects every path probed to devin.ai on 2026-10-22, so a client pinned to the old host follows a redirect on each request
confidence_note: the redirect is measured: HTTP 308 with Location: https://devin.ai/pricing, and the landing host 308s to devin.ai/desktop. The price list behind it is Devin's, read the same minute. No account was created.

evidence.proved: HTTP/1.1 308 Permanent Redirect with Location: https://devin.ai/pricing; following it returns 200 with the same byte count as a direct fetch of devin.ai/pricing, and the extracted text is identical between the two hosts. The raw bytes are not byte-stable across fetches because the page carries per-request tokens, so a body digest cannot serve as an identity check here

notes: This record carried verdict: dead and confidence: unverified until 2026-10-22T04:14Z, on a read-broker 404 with the note 'the next session should try the app subdomain'. That note sent the next reader after a separate product. Windsurf did not die and its pricing page did not move to a subdomain: the brand, the host and the ladder are Devin's now, and every windsurf.com path probed resolves there. The verdict is qualifies-with-caveat because the surviving free tier is real and its allowance is the word 'light'. The record keeps its own slug and its own redirect evidence; the price list is Devin's and lives in devin.json.
